model.name: XGBoost Regressor (Optuna-tuned, experiment E01)
model.preprocessing: ColumnTransformer fitted on the training data of this stage: median imputation for numerics, most-frequent for binary/categorical, one-hot encoding (LOCALITY with min_frequency=25), no scaling (tree model)

training.fitted_on: train + validation partitions (24,328 rows) with hyperparameters and iteration count frozen from validation-based selection
training.data: preprocessing stage model_ready_dataset.csv (28,622 rows, 20 engineered features)
training.split_protocol: grouped 70/15/15 by feature signature, seed 42 (train 20,037 / validation 4,301 / test 4,284; zero signature overlap)
training.target_transform: log1p (inverse: expm1, clipped to [0, log1p(50000)] in log space)
training.selection_rule: lowest validation RMSE across all optimisation-stage experiments (E01: ₹76.28L vs previous winner E00: ₹78.65L; ensemble E09: ₹76.70L)

grouped_cv.note: 3-fold GroupKFold by feature signature, inside the training partition (experiment E10)

test.note: Scored exactly once in the optimisation stage (experiment E11), after selection, on the untouched grouped test partition; reproduced by this packaged artifact at build time.

provenance.supersedes: training stage winner (tuned XGBoost, validation R² 0.8333, test R² 0.7368)
